Debi na u ma\'usa esti na klåsin infutmasion gi ramenta para u fanmatulaika i kulot siha.

rows.backtranslation: This image contains information about what each number used for colour means. AN Paint cannot yet use this information to convert the image. The user remedy preserves sRGB PNG, profile-aware conversion and completion before importing.

rows.backtranslation: The pixels are retained at their positions starting from the upper left of the canvas. When the canvas is made smaller, pixels located outside the right or lower edge are removed. When you use Undo, the removed pixels will be put back.
